name: NTH Grillon (Nicieza & Taverna Hnos. S.A.I.C.A.)
summary: Argentine synthetic-fibre manufacturer (parent founded 1951 in Chivilcoy, Buenos Aires province) that commercialised the Grilon3 filament line in 2015 and began US/EU export by 2017. Filament is extruded in-house alongside the group's textile-fibre production, making it one of the few genuinely Argentine-made filament sources.

product_lines.name: Grilon3 PLA / PLA+
product_lines.notes: Base PLA plus a toughened PLA+ grade; the core volume line.

product_lines.name: Grilon Nylon / Nylon 12
product_lines.notes: Unspecified-grade polyamide plus a PA12 grade; NTH's own nylon-fibre background is the group's core competence.

product_lines.name: Grilon Flex / Gril-Flex
product_lines.notes: Flexible elastomer; the listing does not state whether it is a polyester/SEBS TPE or a urethane, so the generic tpe id is used rather than a TPU shore grade.

product_lines.name: Grilon POM
product_lines.notes: Polyoxymethylene (acetal). No POM id exists in the catalog, so no filament_ids are mapped - recorded here as an open catalog gap.

additional_notes: Street pricing roughly USD 14-20/kg. The Grilon3 e-commerce site is the retail arm; nth.com.ar is the industrial parent. A POM (acetal) line is offered but the catalog has no POM filament entry, so that product line carries no filament_ids.

provenance.conflicts: Production volumes and the exact extrusion site are not published; in-house manufacture rests on the company's own account. Grilon Flex chemistry (TPE vs TPU) is not stated.
